info.title: CodeSentra API
info.description: Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. Long operations return 202 with a run id. Endpoints for later phases answer 501.

get.summary: Liveness plus database and queue checks

post.summary: Send a sign-in link by email
post.description: Always answers 202, whether or not the address has an account, so the endpoint cannot be used to discover users.

post.summary: Exchange a sign-in link token for a session

get.summary: The signed-in user and their organizations

post.summary: Create an organization (you become its owner)
Add a member by email (admin or owner)
post.description: Creates the user if they have never signed in; they join on their first sign-in with that address.

delete.summary: Remove a member (admin or owner; anyone may remove themselves)

post.summary: Create a project with an optional repository and deploy URLs

delete.summary: Delete a project and its runs (admin or owner)

post.summary: Run a platform diagnostic (database, queue, object storage)
post.description: Verifies the CodeSentra pipeline end to end for this project's organization. Watch it with GET /v1/runs/{id}/stream.

get.summary: A run with its steps and coverage gaps

get.description: Emits `run` events whose data is a full Run snapshot: one immediately, then one after every step or status change. The stream ends after the run reaches a terminal status. A `: ping` comment is sent every 15 s.

Full check: Scan + Pulse, then Link (Phase 4)
